content.short: Hydralands is a mythic realm RPG on Cardano where players use NFT heroes to battle and earn rewards.
content.description: Hydralands is an immersive browser-based role-playing game (RPG) set in a persistent mythic universe on the Cardano blockchain. To access the game's full features, including PVP battles, Hydra challenges, and level-based progression, players must hold a valid NFT Hero. The platform features a dynamic leaderboard system and an in-game item shop where players can enhance their characters using rewards earned through gameplay. By blending strategic combat with blockchain-based ownership, Hydralands provides a rewarding and competitive experience for the Cardano gaming community.
content.meta: Hydralands is a Cardano mythic RPG featuring NFT hero battles and persistent progression. Explore Hydralands now on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
